side_missions.title: Pack Movements
side_missions.description: League High Command wants a full tactical assessment of Iron Wolf fleet capabilities. Dave knows that means getting close — dangerously close — to wolves who shoot first and don't bother with questions.

objectives.description: Conduct reconnaissance on Iron Wolf fleet formations
Plant tracking beacons on Wolf capital ships
Relay tactical data to League Command

side_missions.title: The Honour Accord
side_missions.description: The Knight Orders are fractured, and Dave sees an opportunity. If the League can secure an alliance with the breakaway faction, it shifts the entire balance of power. But knights have long memories and longer grudges.

objectives.description: Negotiate alliance terms with the Knight dissidents
Protect the Knight delegation from loyalist attackers

side_missions.title: Resource Claim Delta
side_missions.description: League surveyors have identified a potential crystal deposit in the Iron Expanse. Dave is tasked with securing the site and establishing a League mining outpost before competitors arrive. Standard procedure — except nothing in the Expanse is standard.

objectives.description: Survey and verify the crystal deposit
Establish a defensive perimeter around the site

side_missions.title: Chain of Command
side_missions.description: Intelligence suggests Aristotle has been making side deals with factions hostile to the League. Dave's superiors want proof. Dave wants the truth — even if it means questioning everything he thought he knew about the cat pirate.

objectives.description: Review Aristotle's trade records and contacts
Determine the truth behind the allegations
